The glossary gives Pashto meanings for hard words, lesson by lesson. The English glosses are SpaceBook additions. Some glossary lesson headings (for example صفائي, کونتره, همدردي, د ماشومانو سندرې) do not match the lesson titles in this edition's contents; they are kept as printed.
The glossary glosses شناز (Foods lesson) as an inflated skin float, while the lesson itself uses it for a stomach ache; both are kept as printed.

Possible misprint kept as printed: Noor-ul-Amin Yousafzai's birth year is given as 1922, which sits oddly with a BA from Swabi College; it may be a misprint, but no source here can confirm the correct year.
